title: Privacy Policy
effective: Version 1.0 · Effective Date: July 7, 2026 · Last Updated: July 7, 2026

blocks.t: Palmera is an international digital marketplace, concierge, and lifestyle platform designed to help users discover, organize, reserve, purchase, and enjoy high-quality experiences through a single platform.

Depending on the services available in a user’s location, Palmera may allow individuals and groups to discover and interact with restaurants, cafés, hotels, wellness providers, beach clubs, nightlife venues, transportation providers, tourism operators, entertainment providers, luxury experiences, events, concierge services, membership benefits, and other lifestyle experiences offered by independent third parties.

Palmera also provides technology services that may include personalized recommendations, AI-powered concierge assistance, itinerary planning, booking coordination, social features, loyalty programs, messaging tools, and other services designed to improve the user experience.
This Privacy Policy explains how Palmera collects, uses, shares, stores, transfers, protects, and otherwise processes personal information when individuals interact with our Platform.
By accessing or using the Platform, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.
For purposes of this Privacy Policy:
“Palmera,” “we,” “our,” or “us” refers to Palmera Services LLC, a limited liability company organized under the laws of the United States.
Palmera currently conducts marketplace operations in partnership with local operating entities within Senegal and may expand operations into additional jurisdictions in the future.

Although certain operational services may be performed through local affiliates, representatives, payment partners, or operational entities, Palmera Services LLC remains responsible for operating the Platform and managing this Privacy Policy unless otherwise stated.

Palmera primarily operates as a technology platform and marketplace connecting users with independent businesses and service providers.

Independent Providers remain responsible for their own business operations, customer interactions, legal compliance, pricing, licenses, insurance, and service delivery.

Because of this marketplace structure, certain information may be shared with Providers when necessary to facilitate reservations, bookings, purchases, customer support, legal compliance, or service fulfillment.

9. ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (“AI”), AUTOMATED PROCESSING, AND PERSONALIZATION
Artificial intelligence is an important component of the Palmera Platform.

Our goal is to use AI responsibly to improve the user experience while maintaining transparency, protecting user privacy, supporting human decision-making, and respecting applicable legal requirements.

This section explains how Palmera may use artificial intelligence, machine learning, automated systems, personalization technologies, and similar technologies now and as the Platform continues to evolve.
For additional information regarding our lawful basis for processing Personal Information, see Section 4 (Legal Bases for Processing Personal Information).
For additional information regarding your rights relating to automated processing, see Section 13 (Your Privacy Rights).
Palmera believes artificial intelligence should enhance—not replace—the human experience.

Our AI systems are designed to assist users in discovering Experiences, planning itineraries, organizing reservations, finding recommendations, communicating more efficiently, and navigating the Platform.

Artificial intelligence is intended to support users by providing useful information and recommendations. Final decisions regarding reservations, purchases, travel plans, payments, and participation in Experiences always remain with the user.
Depending upon the features available at a given time, Palmera may use artificial intelligence and related technologies to:
